original_test_intent: Validate NVIDIA processor fatal uncorrectable-error detection and platform containment while preserving the source's intended CPU RAS coverage, once the missing injection and acceptance contract is supplied.
original_method: Do not inject under the current source. Obtain a pinned NVIDIA/platform procedure, map CPU target and error type, establish console/OOB recovery, baseline CPU/RAS state, run one owner-approved fatal stimulus, correlate reset/containment and fresh BERT/CPER/SEL evidence, then prove reboot and processor/workload recovery.
manual_activity: The NVIDIA/platform RAS owner must author the missing processor-fatal procedure and Criteria, select the supported tool/target, supervise the one-shot destructive test and own recovery.
required_inputs: Pinned authoritative NVIDIA/platform processor RAS injection tool, specification, version and checksum
Supported CPU/platform/firmware/OS matrix and exact target/socket/core/error-index mapping
Fatal UCE command and proof of its error type and trigger point
Expected containment, reset/power action, BERT/CPER/MCA/SEL fields and timing
Independent console/OOB access, boot-loop escape and recovery image/procedure
Post-recovery CPU inventory, topology, firmware, workload and persistent-state acceptance
safety_requirements: No injection until Procedure and Criteria are formally approved
Dedicated non-production SUT with independent OOB, serial console, recoverable boot media and platform owner present
Capture baseline without clearing forensic logs; preserve first-failure/reset evidence
One target once; no automatic retry after a fatal/reset outcome
Abort escalation and use owner recovery if the command/target differs, reset loops, firmware stalls or evidence is absent
agent_execution_scope: Inventory platform/CPU/firmware/OS and collect read-only baseline logs and recovery readiness
Validate supplied documents and command semantics during a future fresh review
Do not choose an injector, fabricate a command or target, clear logs, inject, reset, recover, retry or assign a DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Replace TBD Procedure and Criteria with an authoritative CPU-fatal contract
Approve the tool, target, containment/reset and evidence matrix
Issue the final result only after recovery proof

independent_technical_reasoning: A fatal processor UCE can remove the very OS path that would otherwise collect evidence. Therefore the test needs persistent firmware records and independent console/OOB capture, plus a defined reset and boot oracle. With both Procedure and Criteria absent, choosing a tool from another case would be unsafe and would not preserve target-specific coverage.
